parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe made of plastic, representing the Earth with printed maps on its surface.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface showing geographical information and can rotate around its axis for viewing different regions.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around its tilted axis within the supporting frame.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base structure of the globe made of wood, supporting the spherical part and providing stability.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the rotating sphere in place and ensures the globe stands upright on a surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a fixed support for the rotating sphere.
